The name Aigul is also associated with the qualities of a person who is kind, gentle, and compassionate, and is often given to girls born into Muslim families. In modern times, the name Aigul has become popular in many countries and is often used as a given name for girls. The name Aigul is also used in various forms and variations, including Aygul, Aigul, and Aigul.
